scope_of_work: Conduct statutory audit of financial statements in accordance with Standards on Auditing issued by ICAI
Examination of books of accounts, vouchers, and supporting documents
Verification of assets, liabilities, income, and expenditure
Review of internal controls and accounting policies
Assessment of going concern and compliance with applicable accounting standards
Reporting under CARO (Companies Auditor's Report Order), if applicable
Issuance of Independent Auditor's Report
deliverables: Audited Financial Statements (Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow, Notes)
Management Letter with observations and recommendations
Tax Audit Report coordination (if combined engagement)
statutory_audit.timeline: 4-8 weeks from receipt of complete information
statutory_audit.payment_terms: 50% on engagement acceptance, 50% on delivery of final report

scope_of_work: Conduct tax audit under Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act, 1961
Verification of books of accounts and financial records
Examination of compliance with provisions of the Income Tax Act
Review of TDS/TCS compliance and payments
Verification of GST reconciliation with books of accounts
Reporting in Form 3CA/3CB and Form 3CD as applicable
Filing of Tax Audit Report on the Income Tax e-filing portal
tax_audit.timeline: 3-6 weeks from receipt of complete information
tax_audit.payment_terms: 50% on engagement acceptance, 50% on filing of report

scope_of_work: Conduct internal audit as per the scope defined in consultation with management
Review of internal controls, processes, and standard operating procedures
Transaction testing and sample verification
Compliance review of statutory and regulatory requirements
Evaluation of risk management framework
Assessment of efficiency and effectiveness of operations
Quarterly/periodic reporting to the Audit Committee / Management
deliverables: Internal Audit Report with findings and observations
Follow-up reports on previous audit observations
internal_audit.timeline: Ongoing engagement with quarterly reporting cycles
internal_audit.payment_terms: Equal quarterly installments, payable in advance

scope_of_work: Conduct audit of the bank branch as per RBI guidelines and LFAR requirements
Verification of advances, deposits, and investment portfolios
Review of KYC/AML compliance
Examination of NPA classification and provisioning
Verification of income recognition and interest calculation
Assessment of internal controls and housekeeping
Completion of Long Form Audit Report (LFAR)
bank_branch_audit.timeline: 2-4 weeks as per the schedule provided by the bank
bank_branch_audit.payment_terms: As per bank's payment schedule, typically within 30 days of report submission

scope_of_work: Compilation of income details from all sources (salary, house property, capital gains, business/profession, other sources)
Review of Form 16, Form 26AS/AIS, and TIS
Computation of total income and tax liability
Identification of applicable deductions and exemptions under Chapter VI-A
Preparation and e-filing of Income Tax Return in the applicable ITR form
Verification and e-verification of the filed return
deliverables: Computation of Total Income and Tax Liability
Filed Income Tax Return with acknowledgement
Tax planning suggestions for the next financial year
itr_individual.timeline: 5-7 working days from receipt of complete information
itr_individual.payment_terms: 100% in advance or 50% advance and 50% on filing

scope_of_work: Review of HUF income from all sources
Compilation and verification of income details with supporting documents
Computation of total income considering HUF-specific provisions
Identification of applicable deductions and exemptions
Preparation and e-filing of Income Tax Return
E-verification of the filed return
deliverables: Computation of Total Income and Tax Liability
Filed Income Tax Return with acknowledgement
itr_huf.timeline: 5-7 working days from receipt of complete information

scope_of_work: Review of partnership/LLP income and partner-wise allocation
Verification of books of accounts and financial statements
Computation of total income including partner remuneration and interest
Review of Section 40(b) limits for partner remuneration
Preparation and e-filing of Income Tax Return (ITR-5)
E-verification of the filed return
deliverables: Computation of Total Income and Tax Liability
Filed Income Tax Return with acknowledgement
itr_partnership.timeline: 7-10 working days from receipt of complete information

scope_of_work: Review of audited financial statements and audit report
Computation of total income under the Income Tax Act
MAT/AMT computation under Section 115JB/115JC (if applicable)
Review of carry forward losses, depreciation, and deductions
Preparation of tax computation and e-filing of ITR-6
Reconciliation with Form 26AS/AIS
E-verification of the filed return
deliverables: Filed Income Tax Return (ITR-6) with acknowledgement
itr_company.timeline: 7-14 working days from receipt of audited financials

scope_of_work: Review of trust/society income and application of funds
Verification of compliance with Section 11, 12, and 13 provisions
Assessment of accumulation and deemed income provisions
Review of Form 10/10B filing requirements
Preparation and e-filing of Income Tax Return (ITR-7)
E-verification of the filed return
deliverables: Computation of Total Income and Tax Liability
Income & Application statement as per IT Act
Filed Income Tax Return (ITR-7) with acknowledgement
itr_trust.timeline: 7-10 working days from receipt of complete information

scope_of_work: Compilation and review of sales and purchase data
Reconciliation of input tax credit with GSTR-2B
Preparation and filing of GSTR-1 (outward supplies)
Preparation and filing of GSTR-3B (summary return)
ITC reconciliation and mismatch resolution
Advisory on GST compliance issues
gst_monthly.timeline: By 11th and 20th of the following month respectively
gst_monthly.payment_terms: Monthly retainer, payable in advance by the 5th of each month

scope_of_work: Compilation and review of quarterly sales and purchase data
ITC reconciliation with GSTR-2B for the quarter
Preparation and filing of GSTR-1 (quarterly) or IFF
Preparation and filing of GSTR-3B (quarterly)
Advisory on QRMP scheme compliance
gst_quarterly.timeline: Within 13 days of quarter end for GSTR-1, by 22nd/24th for GSTR-3B

scope_of_work: Reconciliation of turnover as per books with GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B
ITC reconciliation for the entire financial year
Preparation of GSTR-9 (Annual Return)
Preparation of GSTR-9C (Reconciliation Statement) if applicable
HSN-wise summary preparation
Resolution of mismatches and discrepancies
gst_annual.timeline: 4-6 weeks from availability of complete data

scope_of_work: Advisory on company structure, authorized capital, and object clause
Obtaining Digital Signature Certificates (DSC) for proposed directors
Name reservation through RUN (Reserve Unique Name) service
Drafting of Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA)
Filing of SPICe+ form with MCA
Obtaining Certificate of Incorporation, PAN, and TAN
Assistance with opening of bank account
deliverables: PAN and TAN of the company
Company Master Data from MCA portal
company_incorporation.timeline: 10-15 working days from submission of complete documents
company_incorporation.payment_terms: 100% in advance (professional fees separate from government fees)

scope_of_work: Advisory on LLP structure and designated partners
Obtaining DSCs for designated partners
Name reservation through RUN-LLP service
Drafting of LLP Agreement
Filing of FiLLiP form with MCA
Obtaining Certificate of Incorporation and PAN/TAN
deliverables: PAN and TAN of the LLP
llp_registration.timeline: 10-12 working days from submission of complete documents
llp_registration.payment_terms: 100% in advance (professional fees separate from government fees)

scope_of_work: Preparation and filing of Annual Return (MGT-7/MGT-7A)
Preparation and filing of Financial Statements (AOC-4/AOC-4 CFS)
Filing of ADT-1 (Auditor Appointment) if applicable
Drafting of Board Resolutions and Minutes
Maintenance of Statutory Registers
Advisory on event-based compliances during the year
deliverables: Compliance calendar for the next year
roc_annual_compliance.timeline: Within 30 days of AGM for AOC-4 and 60 days for MGT-7
roc_annual_compliance.payment_terms: Annual retainer, payable in advance or 50-50 split

scope_of_work: Compilation of TDS/TCS deduction details for the quarter
Verification of TDS rates and threshold limits
Preparation and filing of TDS returns (Form 24Q, 26Q, 27Q as applicable)
Generation and distribution of Form 16/16A to deductees
Reconciliation with Form 26AS
Advisory on TDS compliance and correction statements
deliverables: Filed TDS Returns with provisional receipt
TDS compliance summary for the quarter
tds_return.timeline: Within due dates prescribed under the Income Tax Act

scope_of_work: Day-to-day recording of financial transactions in accounting software
Bank reconciliation on a monthly basis
Accounts receivable and payable management
Preparation of monthly/quarterly Management Information System (MIS) reports
Payroll processing and salary disbursement support
Preparation of provisional financial statements
Coordination with statutory auditors
bookkeeping.timeline: Ongoing monthly engagement with reports by 10th of following month
bookkeeping.payment_terms: Monthly retainer, payable in advance by the 1st of each month

scope_of_work: Review of financial records and supporting documents relevant to the certificate
Verification and computation of the certified figures
Issuance of certificate in the prescribed format
UDIN generation for the certificate
Coordination with the requesting authority/bank if needed
deliverables: Signed and stamped certificate in the prescribed/required format
certification.timeline: 3-5 working days from receipt of complete information

scope_of_work: Understanding client's specific advisory requirements
Research and analysis of applicable laws, regulations, and standards
Preparation of advisory opinion/memorandum
Discussion and presentation of recommendations
Follow-up support for implementation of recommendations
advisory_consulting.timeline: As mutually agreed based on the scope of advisory
advisory_consulting.payment_terms: Hourly billing with monthly invoicing, or fixed fee for defined scope
